stem: Based on the time line and your knowledge of U.S. history, why did John Lewis receive the Presidential Medal of Freedom?

options.label: A
options.text: He used activism and government legislation to support conservative causes.

options.label: B
options.text: He used court cases and lobbyist activities to extend social segregation.

options.label: C
options.text: He used citizen petitions and armed protests to increase suffrage rights.

options.label: D
options.text: He used peaceful protest and political action to expand civil rights.

visual_elements:
Select Events in the Life of John Lewis
1961 Participates in the Freedom Rides movement
1963 Represents the Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee at the March on Washington
1965 Leads a voting rights march from Selma to Montgomery, Alabama
1987-2020 Member of the U.S. House of Representatives
2011 Presented with the Presidential Medal of Freedom by President Obama
